fills.researcher_notes: This is the field-onstream-date proxy the protocol explicitly asks to flag as low-tier rather than pass off as a pipeline-specific date -- no source names this pipeline itself with a year. Wikipedia's 'Qadirpur gas field' page: 'Discovered in March 1990' and 'Gas production on this field commenced in September 1995 by Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto' (a specific, checkable inauguration event, not a vague estimate). This 30-inch Qadirpur-to-Bhong line is confirmed as the field's own current delivery mainline by SNGPL's own asset register, 'TRANSMISSION SYSTEM As at June 30, 2018' (SNGPLAR-2018.pdf, printed p.32, row 19): 'QADIRPUR LINE / 30 / 53.13' km mainline -- an EXACT match to this row's Diameter (30) and LengthKnown (53.13) (verifier FAILs on this large PDF -- documented large-PDF false negative, manually confirmed via pdftotext -layout). NOTE: a superficially similar-sounding asset, '36" Dia 43.49 Miles Qadirpur-Bhong Line' (69.98 km), appears in the same report's Musharaka fixed-asset note (printed p.135) -- that is a DIFFERENT, larger-diameter pipe on a related but distinct corridor, and I have NOT used it to source this row; flagging it only so a future researcher doesn't conflate the two. No source pins a construction year specific to the 30in/53.13km line beyond the field's 1995 onstream date, so tier=low; a human may prefer 'circa 1995' phrasing over a bare year, or UNRESOLVED.
